# 1 Chronicles 3 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 1 Chronicles 3 (24 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 4

---

## V.1 — Mother identification style
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "by Ahinoam the Jezreelitess" / **PNEUMA:** "whose mother was Ahinoam from Jezreel"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "by Ahinoam the Jezreelitess" — preserves the Hebrew construction without expansion.

---

## V.5 — Bathshua name form
- **All agents:** "Bathshua" — consensus. The Chronicler's form is distinct from "Bathsheba" in Samuel.
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "Bathshua" — no substantive disagreement.

---

## V.17 — "the captive" vs. "who was taken into exile"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "the captive" / **PNEUMA:** "who was taken into exile"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "the captive" — preserves the single-word Hebrew descriptor *assir*.

---

## V.10-14 — "his son" repetition
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "Abijah his son, Asa his son..." / **PNEUMA:** "followed by Abijah, then Asa..."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "his son" formula preserved — characteristic Chronicler style.

---
*— SOPHIA*
